title: My Family
sentences: My name is Aziz.
Mening ismim Aziz.
I live in Tashkent with my family.
Men oilam bilan Toshkentda yashayman.
There are five people in my family.
Oilamizda besh kishi bor.
My father is a doctor.
Otam shifokor.
My mother is a teacher at a school.
Onam maktabda o'qituvchi.
I have one brother and one sister.
Mening bitta akam va bitta singlim bor.
My brother is twenty years old.
Akam yigirma yoshda.
My sister is six, and she likes cats.
Singlim olti yoshda, u mushuklarni yaxshi ko'radi.
In the evening, we eat dinner together.
Kechqurun biz birga kechki ovqat yeymiz.
I love my family very much.
Men oilamni juda yaxshi ko'raman.

title: My Day
sentences: I get up at seven o'clock.
Men soat yettida turaman.
I wash my face and drink tea.
Yuzimni yuvaman va choy ichaman.
For breakfast, I eat bread and eggs.
Nonushtaga non va tuxum yeyman.
I go to work by bus.
Ishga avtobusda boraman.
I work in an office from nine to five.
Men to'qqizdan beshgacha ofisda ishlayman.
At one o'clock, I have lunch with my friends.
Soat birda do'stlarim bilan tushlik qilaman.
In the evening, I watch TV or read a book.
Kechqurun televizor ko'raman yoki kitob o'qiyman.
I go to bed at eleven.
Soat o'n birda uxlashga yotaman.

title: At the Market
sentences: On Sunday, I go to the market with my mother.
Yakshanba kuni onam bilan bozorga boraman.
The market is big and very busy.
Bozor katta va juda gavjum.
We buy fruit and vegetables there.
U yerdan meva va sabzavot sotib olamiz.
My mother asks, "How much are these apples?"
Onam so'raydi: "Bu olmalar qancha turadi?"
The man says, "Ten thousand a kilo."
Sotuvchi aytadi: "Kilosi o'n ming."
The price is good, so we buy two kilos.
Narxi yaxshi, shuning uchun ikki kilo olamiz.
Tomatoes are cheap today too.
Bugun pomidor ham arzon.
We go home with three heavy bags.
Uchta og'ir sumka bilan uyga qaytamiz.

title: My Best Friend
sentences: My best friend is Sardor.
Eng yaqin do'stim Sardor.
He is tall and he has short black hair.
U baland bo'yli, sochlari qisqa va qora.
He is very funny and kind.
U juda kulgili va mehribon.
We are in the same class at school.
Biz maktabda bir sinfda o'qiymiz.
Sardor likes sport very much.
Sardor sportni juda yaxshi ko'radi.
At the weekend, we play football in the park.
Dam olish kunlari parkda futbol o'ynaymiz.
After the game, we drink cold water and talk.
O'yindan keyin sovuq suv ichib, gaplashamiz.
He is a good friend.
U yaxshi do'st.
